items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. I saw that in the article that Whitney Balliett did in The New Yorker.

ctx.x: I said, 'Here! You wanna see somethin'?' Here's what happened. She told me...she told me she wanted to see me and sent her name over here and everything...told me where to meet her at and everything, and I said, 'I went and met her.' And he left me alone forever then. He didn't bother me no more at all. He said, right today, that Joe Turner had all the chicks: 'Never seen a man with so many women.' I was young and dumb and full of fun.

Yeah. I saw that in the article that Whitney Balliett did in The New Yorker. He quotes Barney Josephson as saying that the women would go wild when they came in to see you at the club. What happened to the bean?
I took the bean and flushed it down the toilet. I got so much publicity on it that I got scared myself.
